entities.name: Libration of Yotia
entities.description: Campaign to liberate the province of Yotia from Fallaji control.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms who led the campaign.

entities.name: Martyrs of Korlis
entities.description: Slaughter that forced the campaign upon Urza.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Urza's push into the Great Desert toward Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, in his new capital of Tomakul.

events.summary: After the slaughter of the Martyrs of Korlis, Urza and Tawnos assembled a large army to liberate Yotia.
events.quote: The campaign was forced upon Urza as the Lord Protector of the Combined Kingdoms after the slaughter of the Martyrs of Korlis .

events.summary: The Fallaji fell back, burning the ground behind them, and nearly all of Yotia was liberated.
events.quote: The Fallaji fell back, burning the ground behind them

events.summary: Urza pressed on into the Great Desert, starting his Tomakul Campaign.
events.quote: Urza pressed on into the Great Desert , starting his Tomakul Campaign

relations.quote: He and Tawnos assembled a large army
